dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible symmetric, linear narrowing from the maximum lateral width at mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Predominantly off-white to very light grey across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Subtle, diffuse darker pigmentation clusters visible around the blowhole and along the posterior dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse transition with smooth gradients between slightly darker grey regions and the lighter baseline tone.

other_distinctive_markers: Centrally positioned, high-contrast circular blowhole at the anterior end; pronounced longitudinal dorsal ridge prominent in the posterior half.
